title: Science Utopia? Closed-Loop LLM Simulation of Academic Research Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2610.01257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scientific progress emerges from a longitudinal ecosystem in which researchers, institutions, funding agencies, collaboration networks, and the scientific literature co-evolve. As AI becomes increasingly involved throughout the scientific research cycle, understanding these interconnected and evolving processes becomes increasingly important. We introduce SciUtopia, a persistent, closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework for studying academic research ecosystems. SciUtopia models interconnected scientific processes such as research-direction choice, collaboration, submission, peer review, resubmission, citation, funding, and researcher attrition, while maintaining evolving states across simulated years. Its configurable institutional mechanisms and information channels provide a controlled testbed for matched counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions. Across 61 simulation worlds, SciUtopia simulates over 40,000 researchers

translated_title: 科学乌托邦？学术研究生态系统的闭环大语言模型模拟
translated_abstract: 科学进步源于一个纵向演化的生态系统，其中研究人员、科研机构、资助机构、合作网络和科学文献共同演化。随着人工智能在科学研究全周期中的参与日益深入，理解这些相互关联且不断演进的过程变得越来越重要。我们提出了SciUtopia，一个用于研究学术研究生态系统的持久性闭环大语言模型智能体模拟框架。SciUtopia对研究方向选择、合作、投稿、同行评审、再次投稿、引用、资助和研究人员流失等相互关联的科学过程进行建模，并在模拟年份间保持持续演化的状态。其可配置的科研制度机制和信息渠道为匹配的反事实实验和有针对性的干预提供了可控的试验平台。在61个模拟世界中，SciUtopia模拟了超过40,000名研究人员。
tldr: 提出了SciUtopia，一个持久性闭环LLM智能体模拟框架，能够模拟学术研究生态系统中研究方向选择、合作、投稿评审、引用和资助等相互关联的科学过程在多年尺度上的共同演化，并支持反事实实验与干预研究。
en_tdlr: SciUtopia is a persistent closed-loop LLM-agent simulation framework that models the long-term co-evolution of interconnected scientific processes—such as research-direction choice, collaboration, peer review, citation, and funding—within academic research ecosystems, enabling counterfactual experiments and targeted interventions.
